theme: Mutual fund literacy: what is an expense ratio, active vs passive, fund categories
headline: Understanding Expense Ratios in Mutual Funds
body: Expense ratio represents the annual cost of managing your investment, expressed as a percentage of assets under management.
caption: Every fund incurs operational costs for management, administration, and compliance. Lower ratios mean more of your money stays invested. Compare ratios while evaluating funds across similar categories. #MutualFundLiteracy #ExpenseRatio #InvestingBasics #WealthBuilding #SmartInvesting
